title: I "glide" around in my dream spaces - anyone else?
content: So, the way I sometimes get around in my mall world and other places is like gliding on my knees on the floor or sometimes standing up. I will propel myself by grabbing the carpet or wall and pulling or pushing off it. I don't think I'm on any device or vehicle. It's funny in that it totally reminds me of the goal scorer celebrating in this ad: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bULNticawIU](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bULNticawIU) That commercial is hilaarious, but it's pretty much the way I seem to move through dream spaces - quite fast. Faster than walking - I pass a lot of people in huge buildings. I can steer and maneuver by leaning. Anyway, I just wondered how others traverse environments in your dreams. Any other "gliders" out there?
